title: HS60004: Industrial Relations
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Evolution of industrial relations, IR system in India; Labour-management
relations: trade unionism, collective bargaining, employee grievances, employee
discipline, industrial conflict, labour welfare and social security; Workers
participation in management; India and international labour standards; Judicial
activism, alignment, labour policy and industrialization, strategies; New
paradigms of industrial relations.
